summary: The statement and proof are correct with no gaps. Base symmetry and convexity give identical paired fibers contained in the positive-volume actual central fiber, so the original marginal mean is defined and belongs to that fiber. The original probabilities produce exactly the stated mixed-integer measure and marginal density; the volume comparison yields domination by M times uniform volume on the actual central fiber. Every nonzero projection has densities, finite moments, and a nondegenerate log-concave reference density with the same meaning and normalization as in 705d93afab077ade. The explicit aliases to 715faf86f9347fdb satisfy all its hypotheses and place both caps at the projection of the single original mean chosen before the direction. The paired-fiber argument transfers that cap bound to all ambient halfspaces, including pure base normals and closed boundary cases, with the asserted factor of one half. Zero-volume fibers have zero measure throughout. The dimension-dependent criterion and its explicit sufficient comparison follow from the stated inequalities for M_n, and the constant lies in the claimed interval.
